scope: Qt-free WAV admission policy and ordered worker decoding with cancellation
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0, PipeWire 1.6.9, libsndfile 1.2.2), docker --network none

engine-only.note: media import is not built without the renderer/libsndfile

pipewire-sanitize.note: wav-import passed under ASan/UBSan; the one failure was pipewire-frame-coded-control, a pre-existing environment flake (see findings)

verified_behaviors: Independent RIFF fixtures: PCM16 mono/stereo, PCM24 and float32 decode to the expected values; integer PCM normalized to [-1,1), float kept unclipped
Rate policy admits files that match the session rate (48 kHz default, 44.1 kHz policy) and refuses others with a message naming both rates
Refusals: missing file, directory, text, truncated header, AIFF, A-law, three channels, empty data, NaN, infinity, over-limit file, invalid policy, pre-set cancel
Inclusive frame limit; a header under-reporting its data cannot bypass the limit
Imported stereo clip prepares through DocumentRenderPlan and renders the authored frames
Worker decodes on a separate thread, completes in order, cancels pending and running requests and shuts down promptly during a 20-second decode
findings: pipewire-frame-coded-control (unchanged by this work) failed intermittently on unmodified main too: 10/25 and 0/25 in two rounds, and the pw-cat reference producer with no fl-live code failed 3/25, while the host load average was about 27. Hosted CI failed once on this test for PR #110 and was rerun.
limits: Offline checks only. No desktop import control, waveform view, loop-range editing or asset persistence yet (#27, #31, #56, #60).
